note: The NBA Cup's title game. ESPN files it with the regular season; the league counts it in no one's record or statistics, so it is left out of the past-season files (tools/drop-cup-finals.mjs, tools/backfill-matchups.js, tools/build-feat-runs.mjs). Add each December's game: [date, home, away, home score, away score]. This season's game is found by rule (cupFinal in src/situations/standings.js).
